Charlie Appleby's strike rate with 2-y-o newcomers is an enviable one and his Royal Acclamation commands obvious respect on racecourse bow. Fellow newcomer Blueabad may emerge next best. ONE NUMBER (USA) ROYAL ACCLAMATION BLUEABAD

races.verdict: OCEAN FORCE is a lightly-raced gelding who hasn't been seen to best effect in qualifying for a mark and could well transform now switched to handicaps for shrewd connections. Both Bajan Bandit and Dandy Khan have contested better races than this lately and are feared most. OCEAN FORCE (IRE) BAJAN BANDIT DANDY KHAN (IRE)

races.verdict: PENNINE WAY is going the right way with progressive efforts at Wolverhampton and Brighton recently and this could be an ideal opportunity for her to get off the mark from a handy stall. Fuseboard isn't so well drawn but beat a subsequent winner with ease last time and could be a threat back up in grade, while Apex Star won't be far away if giving his running. PENNINE WAY FUSEBOARD APEX STAR (IRE)

races.display_title: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: FIORELLA PRINCESS has been absent since running below her best at Nottingham in the spring but she starts out for a new yard who excel with sprinting types and, having proven her effectiveness when fresh earlier in her career, she could well be worth siding with back on the all-weather. Sea Her Excel has landed 2 of her last 3 starts on turf and is feared, along with class-dropping top weight Over Spiced . FIORELLA PRINCESS (IRE) SEA HER EXCEL OVER SPICED

races.display_title: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CAPTAIN COOL left the impression he would have finished closer still but for losing momentum at the last when third behind Sir Tivo here over shorter 32 days ago and, with the Jennie Candlish yard continuing in fine form, he's fancied to emerge victorious on this occasion. Crebilly is potentially well handicapped on the pick of his old chase form and is a threat. Parisencore completes the shortlist back at a more suitable trip. CAPTAIN COOL (IRE) CREBILLY (IRE) SIR TIVO (FR)
